name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: Pick a color from a saturation area, channel sliders, channel inputs, the screen eyedropper or a preset swatch.

parts.name: label
parts.description: Visible label rendered above the control.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether to close the color picker when a swatch is selected

props.name: defaultFormat
props.description:
The initial color format when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color format of the color picker.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the color picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the color picker.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial color value — a CSS color string or a Zag `Color` object.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the color picker is disabled

props.name: format
props.description: The controlled color format to use

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: hideEyeDropper
props.description: Hide the eyedropper button even where the browser supports it.

props.name: hideFormatSelect
props.description: Hide the format select shown next to the channel inputs.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the color picker. Useful for composition.

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description: The initial focus element when the color picker is opened.

props.name: inline
props.description: Whether to render the color picker inline

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the color picker is invalid

props.name: name
props.description: The name for the form input

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the color picker

props.name: openAutoFocus
props.description: Whether to auto focus the color picker when it is opened

props.name: positioning
props.description: The positioning options for the color picker

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the color picker is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the color picker is required

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset swatch colors rendered under the channel inputs.

props.name: value
props.description: Color value — a CSS color string or a Zag `Color` object.

props.name: valueChangeEnd
props.description: Sugar for onValueChangeEnd — fires when the user stops dragging.

events.name: formatChange
events.description: Sugar for onFormatChange — receives the plain format.

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onFormatChange
events.description: Function called when the color format changes

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Handler that is called when the user opens or closes the color picker.

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Handler that is called when the value changes, as the user drags.

events.name: onValueChangeEnd
events.description: Handler that is called when the user stops dragging.

events.name: openChange
events.description: Sugar for onOpenChange — receives the plain boolean, enables `open:=state`.

events.name: valueChange
events.description: Sugar for onValueChange — receives the color as a string, enables `value:=state`.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A color picker with a trigger swatch and popover controls.

examples.title: With swatch presets
examples.source:
import ColorPicker from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/color-picker/color-picker.marko";

static const PRESETS = [
  "#ef4444",
  "#f97316",
  "#eab308",
  "#22c55e",
  "#06b6d4",
  "#3b82f6",
  "#8b5cf6",
  "#ec4899",
  "#000000",
  "#ffffff",
];

<ColorPicker defaultValue="#22c55e" swatches=PRESETS>
  <@label>Accent</@label>
</ColorPicker>
examples.description: Pass `swatches` to render a row of preset colors below the channel inputs.

examples.title: HSL format, no eyedropper
examples.source:
import ColorPicker from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/color-picker/color-picker.marko";

<ColorPicker defaultValue="hsl(200, 90%, 50%)" defaultFormat="hsla" hideEyeDropper>
  <@label>Background</@label>
</ColorPicker>
examples.description: Set `defaultFormat` to start in a different color space, and `hideEyeDropper` to drop the screen eyedropper button.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import ColorPicker from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/color-picker/color-picker.marko"; static const PRESETS = [ "#ef4444", "#f97316", "#eab308", "#22c55e", "#06b6d4", "#3b82f6", "#8b5cf6", "#ec4899", "#000000", "#ffffff", ];
<@label>Controlled color value: ${controlledValue}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled color picker is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.
